name: pagination
summary: Renders safe linked pagination with explicit current, gap, and disabled previous/next semantics.

agent.useWhen: A server-owned result set spans stable navigable destinations and needs page, current, previous, next, and gap controls.
agent.avoidWhen: More results load into one continuous list or page destinations are not safe hrefs; this component does not own routes or result state.

invariants: Exactly one item has kind=current and no href; it receives aria-current=page.
Page items require safe hrefs; previous and next may be links or disabled nonlinks; previous/next links emit rel=prev/next.
Gaps are noninteractive and aria-hidden; hrefs follow the closed safe destination policy.
Labels and href attributes are escaped; no routes, commands, arbitrary HTML, or scripts are emitted.
The fragment contains exactly one [[attributes]], [[label]], and [[items]] slot; expansion is exact and single-pass.

attributes.name: variant
rules: One of standard, outlined, or compact; defaults to standard.
Content consists only of self-closing page helpers and supported template control flow.

attributes.name: kind
rules: One of previous, page, current, next, or gap.

attributes.name: label
rules: A literal or one whole checked string field; must be nonblank plain text.

attributes.name: href
rules: Use a safe internal literal or one whole named route call when this item is enabled and navigable.

attributes.name: disabled
rules: Boolean literal true or false; current items cannot be disabled. Disabled navigable items must not have href; use disabled previous/next items for unavailable adjacent pages.

attributes.name: current
rules: Only valid for kind=current; literal true or false, or one whole checked boolean field. Current items cannot have href or be disabled.
Current and gap items cannot have href; gaps are noninteractive.
Enabled previous, page, and next items require href; disabled navigable items must not have href.
kind=current emits aria-current only when current is omitted, true, or a bound Bool evaluates true; false renders an unmarked span. The final navigation must contain exactly one marked current item.
At least one current helper declaration is required lexically by expansion; ensure the final host-rendered output has exactly one current item.
Host route registration, route argument/type checks, destination safety, binding types, and runtime page/range admission remain host-owned; package metadata does not establish these guarantees.
Labels and destinations are emitted as escaped text and attributes.

examples.name: customer-pages
examples.summary: Previous and next destinations are conditional while a current page is marked explicitly.
examples.template:
<cui-pagination label="Customer pages">
  {% if has_previous %}<cui-page kind="previous" label="Previous" href="{{ routes.customers_page(page=previous_page) }}" />{% else %}<cui-page kind="previous" label="Previous" disabled="true" />{% endif %}
  <cui-page kind="current" label="{{ page_number }}" current="true" />
  {% if has_next %}<cui-page kind="next" label="Next" href="{{ routes.customers_page(page=next_page) }}" />{% endif %}
</cui-pagination>
requirements: Register customers_page route accepting page if using the navigation links.
App provides has_previous and has_next as Bool fields, previous_page and next_page with the route's declared page argument type, and page_number as a formatted string label.
The app/host must ensure the rendered navigation has exactly one current page item and valid page ranges.
